statement.p: Find the length of the curve x = -\left(2+5t\right),\quad y = t-2, z = 5+t, for 3 \le t \le 4.

p.em: (Think of second way that you could calculate this length, too, and see that you get the same result.)

static.solution: \hbox{Length} = \int_3^4 \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2 + (z'(t))^2}\,dt = \int_{3}^{4} \sqrt{(-5)^2+(1)^2+(1)^2}\,dt = \sqrt{27}. This is the length of a straight line from the point (-17,1,8) to (-22,2,9).
